item.title: 20 Questions You Never Asked About Pianists | We Answer Them Anyway
item.description: This video explores the role of pianists outside the classical world through 20 factual Q&As — from icons like Bill Evans, Jerry Lee Lewis, and Dr. John to jazz innovators such as Herbie Hancock and Chick Corea. It covers songwriting, performance styles, and moments that shaped modern piano music.
